title: Product roadmap review
segments: Welcome to our product roadmap review. This is a scripted sample conversation. Today we need to decide what belongs in the first release of our meeting workspace.
Customer interviews point to one problem: people remember the conversation but lose the next step. A searchable transcript and clear action items should come first.
Decision: we will ship timestamped transcripts, evidence links, and editable action items in the first release. We will defer calendar sync until we validate the core workflow.
Maya will review the onboarding copy by Friday. The review should explain recording consent and make the difference between sample content and a real recording clear.
Alex will test citation links and playback before the launch review. Every link must open the correct transcript moment and seek the recording to the same timestamp.
We have not decided whether external sharing should be public. Until we settle permissions, workspace links will require the owner's sign-in. No delivery date is agreed for public sharing.
overview: The team scoped a focused first release around searchable evidence and clear next steps. Calendar sync is deferred; external sharing remains unresolved.

decisions.text: Ship timestamped transcripts, evidence links, and editable action items first; defer calendar sync.

actions.text: Review onboarding copy, including consent and sample-content labels.
Test citation links and recording playback before the launch review.

title: Customer discovery call
segments: This is a scripted customer discovery sample. Our team spends too much time reconstructing decisions after calls. Notes are scattered across documents and chat.
A timestamp matters more than a polished paragraph. If I can open the exact moment, I can check whether we made a decision or only floated an idea.
Decision: we will run a pilot with the product team first. We are not committing the whole company or agreeing to a paid plan.
Nina will collect feedback from the pilot participants next week. We have not settled the success metric yet.
overview: The customer wants traceable decisions and less work reconstructing calls. A product-team pilot is agreed; the success metric remains open.

decisions.text: Run a pilot with the product team before a wider rollout.

title: Engineering sprint planning
segments: This is a scripted engineering planning sample. The sprint goal is to make the meeting evidence workflow reliable across refreshes and retries.
Decision: ownership checks are required on every endpoint, including search, highlights, and recording playback. The browser will never choose the owner ID.
Sam will add two-user isolation tests by Thursday. They should cover a copied meeting link and a highlight that references another meeting's transcript.
Playback links must remain temporary. We will not put private recording URLs into shared notes. The database migration needs to run before the new backend deploys.
overview: Engineering prioritized durable evidence, owner isolation, and private playback. Tests and migration ordering are explicit release gates.

decisions.text: Require ownership checks for search, highlights, and playback; never accept a client-selected owner.

actions.text: Add two-user isolation tests for meeting links and highlights.

title: Founder / investor update
segments: This is a fictional founder update for the demo. The product is being tested as a meeting workspace that connects decisions to their original evidence.
We do not have verified revenue, retention, or adoption metrics to report. The next milestone is a complete walkthrough with a consented recording.
Decision: show one coherent workflow in the demo rather than promise unbuilt integrations. Clearly label simulated capture and sample content.
Riley will prepare the walkthrough script. No deadline was agreed. Public sharing and advanced calendar sync remain outside this release.
overview: The update focuses on a coherent, honest product walkthrough. Business metrics are not available; the team will demonstrate the working evidence flow.

decisions.text: Demonstrate one coherent workflow and label simulated capture and samples clearly.
